summary.text: Charlie Miller, listed as Charles Miller by Ballotpedia and as Charles W. Miller by the General Assembly, is a Republican state representative from North Carolina House District 19 who has served since January 1, 2021, and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026.
He is chief deputy of the Brunswick County Sheriff's Office.

paragraphs.text: Miller graduated from South Brunswick High School in 1984 and earned a degree in basic law enforcement from Cape Fear Community College, according to Ballotpedia.

His career experience includes work as chief deputy of the Brunswick County Sheriff's Office, CEO and owner of Brunswick Embroidery & Screenprinting, regional sales manager of BEST Uniforms Inc., and nuclear security specialist with Progress Energy Nuclear Plant.
Miller is a member of the Pythagoras Masonic Lodge #249.
Miller succeeded Republican Ted Davis Jr. in House District 19, which the General Assembly lists as covering Brunswick and New Hanover counties.

He chairs the Appropriations Subcommittee on Justice and Public Safety, co-chairs the Legislative Ethics Committee and the Joint Legislative Oversight Committee on the North Carolina State Lottery, and is vice chairman of the Appropriations Committee and the Energy and Public Utilities Committee.
